name: ChronoBias
description: ChronoBias is a benchmark for evaluating time-conditional group bias in the time-sensitive knowledge of large language models. It uses a template-based semi-automated generation method to study how group bias varies over time intervals and identifies parametric knowledge bias and time-sensitivity bias as key factors.
reputation: A niche, recently proposed benchmark with limited public adoption so far, mainly cited within the paper and related bias-evaluation work.
notes: Focuses on temporal dynamics of group bias and evaluates retrieval-augmented generation approaches to mitigate bias.
